ALTER TABLE course_plan_request
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_course_plan_path_command_outcome,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_course_plan_path_command_path,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_course_plan_path_command_payload,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_course_plan_path_command_hash,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_course_plan_path_command_expected_version,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_course_plan_path_command_kind,
    DROP CONSTRAINT IF EXISTS ck_course_plan_path_command_all_or_none,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_reused,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_course_id,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_result_code,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_checkpointed_at,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_payload,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_hash,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_expected_version,
    DROP COLUMN IF EXISTS path_command_kind;
